questions: The governance gate verdict is BLOCKED, so implementation must not proceed until the gate is at least QUALIFIED. Please confirm when the gate verdict is upgraded from BLOCKED to QUALIFIED or PROCEED so code generation is permitted (governance rule 4).

Clarify and verify the invalid_request|behaviour decision: should an invalid request be handled exactly as described (status `rejected: invalid_request`, with no store, screen, price, or notification) or is there any alternative behavior? Please verify key invalid_request|behaviour and assertion [A:dt:invalid_request|behaviour@v1].

Confirm the end-to-end flow ordering for the QuoteAPI: is the normative step order `validate > store > screen > decide > price > notify > respond` as proposed in [A:spec:flow|order@v1], or is a different sequence required (e.g., price before screening in some non-outage paths)?

Define and verify the precise pricing formula for TariffEngine.price: is TariffEngine expected to implement pricing decision table DT-P exactly as described in assertions [A:dt:P1|formula@v1], [A:dt:P2|threshold@v1], [A:dt:P2|surcharge@v1], [A:dt:P3|threshold@v1], [A:dt:P3|factor@v1], [A:dt:P3|order@v1], and [A:dt:P4|rounding@v1]? If yes, these must be upgraded from proposed to verified/approved or explicitly blessed as assumptions.

Confirm how quote_id should be populated in the response across all paths: should `quote_id` appear exactly whenever a draft has been successfully stored (including screening outage, review, refusal, and acceptance) as suggested in [A:spec:response|quote_id_presence@v1], and be absent on pure validation or storage-error failures? Please verify this behavior.

Clarify expected behavior on notification failures: should NotificationService failures truly be fire-and-forget with no effect on the stored quote or API response, as proposed in [A:dt:QuoteAPI|on_notification_failure@v1]? This needs verification or explicit acceptance as an assumption.

Confirm what should happen if update_quote (after initial store_draft) fails with StoreUnavailableError in any branch (accept, review, refuse, screening-outage). No explicit rule is given for mid-flow store failures; should the API return `error: store_unavailable`, roll back, or keep the last known draft status? This is currently a gap.

Clarify whether ScreeningService.screen returns a numeric `risk_index` only, or a richer object; and define the exact interface (inputs/outputs and error model) for ScreeningService beyond the documented ScreeningUnavailableError condition.

Clarify how to validate types and numeric formats for weight_kg, distance_km, and declared_value in the handle(request) entrypoint: should strict type checking follow the OpenAPI schema exactly (numbers only), or should strings convertible to numbers be accepted? This is not fully specified.

Confirm how to compute and return fields when screening is unavailable: for status `held_unscreened` under a screening outage, the docs state price must be computed and `hold: true` returned ([A:dt:QuoteAPI|on_screening_outage@v1]); please verify if any additional fields (e.g., risk_index) should be included or explicitly excluded in the API response.

Clarify behavior when ScreeningService.screen returns a risk index outside the documented bands (e.g., negative or > 100): should this be treated as an error, mapped to the nearest band, or rejected as invalid? No rule currently covers this edge case.
Confirm whether TariffEngine.price can itself fail and, if so, what QuoteAPI must do in that case (error status? which value?), since the repository does not declare behavior for pricing failures.
